statement: At least one Russian missile or drone strike on Kyiv city between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-11 is acknowledged by Ukrainian officials and reported by at least two international wire services.
resolution: TRUE if Ukrainian officials acknowledge and two of Reuters, AP, AFP report at least one Russian air attack impacting Kyiv city with strike date between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-11.
failure_condition: No Russian air attack on Kyiv city occurring within the window receives both Ukrainian official acknowledgment and two-wire corroboration by the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The United States and Iran jointly announce a signed ceasefire or framework agreement between 2026-08-12 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the US government and the government of Iran each officially confirm a signed ceasefire or framework agreement announced between 2026-08-12 and 2026-11-30, per two international wire services.
failure_condition: No ceasefire or framework agreement is confirmed by both governments within the window.

resolution: TRUE if CME official settlement data show the WTI front-month contract settling at or above 100.00 USD on any trading day between 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: Every WTI front-month official settlement in the window is below 100.00 USD.
